title: Training in Toilet Use and Self-Reliance
summary: This lesson addresses "training in toilet use and self-reliance" for children from two to three years old. Teach him istinja’ (cleansing after relieving oneself) and its importance, and train him to enter the bathroom with the left foot and exit with the right, while memorizing the du’a (supplication) for entering and exiting to instill these manners as part of his routine. It is advised to begin when the child shows readiness (typically between the ages of two and three). Starting too early before readiness may cause stress and setbacks that prolong the training period. Guide him gently to serve himself and prepare his own needs; this will accustom him early to diligence and self-reliance, protecting him from indulgence and dependency.
try_this: Try this week: Teach him istinja’ and its importance, train him to enter the bathroom with the left foot and exit with the right, and help him memorize the du’a for entering and exiting to instill these good manners as part of his routine.
